nativeValidation.reason: The assigned Linux worker cannot access the macOS host.
nativeValidation.setup: Use a signed-in macOS desktop session with native Safari, Node 24.22.3 and pnpm 10.26.2. Use a clean checkout with the worker change, record the tested SHA and copy the probe to the listed destination. In Safari Settings, Advanced, enable Press Tab to highlight each item on a webpage. Enable Keyboard navigation in macOS System Settings, Keyboard. The WebDriver probe uses a 360 px same-origin frame because Safari can enforce a minimum window width.
commands:
bash -s <<'SAFARI_VALIDATION'
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$root"
export TMPDIR="$root/.t3-tmp"
output="$TMPDIR/safari-usage"
mkdir -p "$output"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git rev-parse HEAD | tee "$output/revision.txt"
sw_vers | tee "$output/macos.txt"
if curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4444/status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Expected unused WebDriver port 4444.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
(
  cd apps/delino-accounts
  exec node node_modules/@rsbuild/core/bin/rsbuild.js dev --no-env --config e2e/rsbuild.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0
) > "$output/rsbuild.log" 2>&1 &
app_pid=$!
/usr/bin/safaridriver -p 4444 > "$output/safaridriver.log" 2>&1 &
driver_pid=$!
cleanup() {
  kill "$app_pid" "$driver_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$app_pid" "$driver_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
app_url=""
for attempt in {1..60}; do
  app_url="$(sed -nE 's/.*(http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+\/billing-usage).*/\1/p' "$output/rsbuild.log")"
  if [[ -n "$app_url" ]] && curl -fsS "$app_url" >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
    curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4444/status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.25
done
kill -0 "$app_pid" "$driver_pid"
test -n "$app_url"
node "$TMPDIR/usage-keyboard-webdriver.mjs" safari http://127.0.0.1:4444 "$app_url" "$output" 2>&1 | tee "$output/results.log"
SAFARI_VALIDATION
expectedResults: The probe exits 0 and logs the native Safari version and platform.

At 360 px, Tab from Previous month focuses the single region named by the native caption. It has an explicit tabindex of 0 and a visible solid 2 px outline. Positive overflow clips Cost at first. ArrowRight reveals it, and ArrowLeft restores scrollLeft 0. Tab moves past the region and Shift+Tab can move back into it and exit backwards.

At 1280 px, the native caption, five headers, and seeded row display in the table. Quantity is 1,048,576 bytes and Cost and monthly total read $0.004567. Previous month shows the empty message and has no focusable usage-table wrapper.
Inspect the two 360 px screenshots for the focus outline and the fully revealed Cost cell. Preserve the revision, environment, log, and screenshots as native evidence.
